_comment: Produces NGM and CGTM graph dumps for the density_vs_ds comparison.
Together with struct_100k.json and struct_sigm_100k.json, these cover all five
strategies. The 100k scale is used because density is measured per node.
Run with the dump hook on:
These route through merge_pair, so the hook catches them. IGTM and HNSWMerger
are covered by struct_100k.json. SIGM needs its own run because it does not
route through merge_pair (save_index=false on its path). Use
graph is insertion-built and ~= INSERT density, so it is optional. INSERT
Canonical (iso-quality winner) config per algorithm, matching the summary rows.
